episode.title: The Three Globalizations
episode.tagline: Humanity should not be divided. Globalization is a powerful force for good. But it is has ebbed and flowed. Are we retreating to a more insular world -- or does globalization continue, but in a modified form?
episode.about: In this episode, Ajay talks about the first two waves of globalisation -- and then explains the term he has coined, 'The Third Globalization.' We still live in a globalised world, he explains -- but with caveats based on economic statecraft. (And yes, he explains what that is!) Amit explains why we should not worry about trade deficits, and why we should celebrate babysitters. Amit then recommends "the greatest podcast of all time,' and Ajay talks about a book that left him transfixed in an Irani cafe.
